cards.title: Triage Vector 1: Render Cold Start (504)
items: Render free-tier instances hibernate after 15 minutes of zero traffic
Always execute pre-pitch warm-up curl 3 minutes before the presentation
If 504 occurs live: Explain microservice auto-scaling while curl re-warms container in 15s

cards.title: Triage Vector 2: RBAC Security Guard (401 / 403)
items: 403 Forbidden is a desired architectural defense when presenting viewer_demo role
Viewer persona cleanly hides Alt+N batch creation and Void invoice action triggers
Single click on quick-fill 'Demo Admin' instantly switches session to editor_admin

cards.title: Triage Vector 3: Ledger & Sequence Safeguards (409 / 422)
items: 422 is an intentional safety boundary: prevents phantom stock and negative warehouse balances
Monotonic sequence uq_invoice_company_sequence guarantees IRD Nepal compliance with zero duplicate bills
Zero database surgery needed: system protects financial truth at the database constraint level
